summary: Nothing new since the last report. call_from_thread is implemented in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state set and cleared in run_async, and tests/test_call_from_thread.py has 8 passing tests. Nothing is committed. The full non-snapshot suite (excluding tests/cli and tests/devtools, which can't be collected because click and aiohttp are missing from the shared venv) shows the same 68 pre-existing failures before and after the change, caused by async tests the venv can't run without pytest-asyncio.
